sourceTitle: Grilled Romaine with Lemon Tahini Dressing
sourceText:
Grilled Romaine with Lemon Tahini Dressing
By: Tracy
Published: Wednesday, June 10, 2015 - 1:22am

Ingredients




1 head of romaine lettuce
1 tablespoon of olive oil
1 pinch of salt
1 pinch of oregano
fresh ground pepper to taste
Lemon Tahini Dressing:
1/4 cup tahini
2 tablespoons olive oil
juice from 2 lemons
1 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 Pre-heat grill. 2 Add tahini, lemon juice, and salt to food processor and blend. While blending add olive oil and process until smooth. 3 Remove large leaves off of lettuce head. Slice a thin piece off of the base of the head, careful to keep lettuce head in tact. Cut off a couple of inches off of the top of lettuce. Keep discarded leaves and tops for another salad. 4 Mix in a small bowl the tablespoon of olive oil, oregano, pepper, and salt. Brush outside of lettuce with oil mixture, spreading it evenly. 5 Place on grill on medium to high and grill for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until outside leaves are slightly charred. 6 Drizzle with Lemon Tahini Dressing and serve immediately.

About

Let your grill do all the work this summer, even with your salad!  Toss your romaine lettuce on to grill then drizzle it with a from scratch lemon tahini dressing and you have the perfect summer salad!
